bioAdditions: His younger brother William Bernard McGuire's 1927 Luzerne marriage application names their parents as James McGuire, born at Danville, Pa., and Anna Jones, born in England, both dead by Nov 1927 (S1). FamilySearch lists Frank's siblings as Edward Joseph (1885-1948), Mary (1887-1950), James Joseph (1889-1957), Joseph (1894-1910), Marguerite (1895-1961), Vincent Joseph (1901-1987), Theresa A. (1904-1998), William Bernard (1906-1975), Anna C. (1909-1964) and Joseph (1913-1963) (S2; derivative).
